purpose: Proof-order step 2 support for the fused residual-add/RMSNorm/INT4 gate-up candidate: real checkpoint weights plus fp32 reference outputs, generated entirely on CPU (safe on the 15 GiB host).

proof_results.dequant_vs_ark_oracle: exact (max_abs_diff=0.0) for layers 0 and 30, gate and up
proof_results.compare_self_check: identity candidate OK; +0.01 perturbed candidate FAILs as required
proof_results.ark_xpu_lib: not loaded on this host (expected); CPU oracle path used

notes: Weights are real checkpoint bytes (layers 0 and 30); h/r activation rows are deterministic synthetic fp16 (seed 20260818 + layer) until the measuring host drops in a real activation dump
reference outputs cover the exact TP2 local view: rank r sees concat(gate[:, r*8704:(r+1)*8704], up[:, r*8704:(r+1)*8704]) at M=4, K=5120
compare subcommand scores a candidate kernel's safetensors against these references (default atol/rtol 1e-3)
